formula: C=(L/(4 pi^2))*integral_cell |Delta psi_ExEy(s)|^2 ds / average_K integral_cell |psi_K_ExEy(s)|^2 ds; L=16a
derivation: Integration by parts of the Bloch integral gives f_l(s)~Delta psi(s)/(2 pi i l) at an internal spectral jump; the normalized line intensity has a cell-averaged C/x^2 tail. The normalization is measured from the saved full-period initial packet, using Parseval total/Nk.
limitations: Asymptotic prediction for initial packet from the internal primitive-q wrap only
Finite-period aliasing and outer supercell-edge jump are omitted here
No claim that this alone explains the evolved slow-drive packet-width change
